description: This Java source file contains utility methods for implementing a WebDAV servlet in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for date formatting, parsing XML documents from HTTP requests, extracting user credentials from requests, and maintaining relevant constants.

classes.name: WebDavUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date formatting, XML parsing from HTTP requests, user credential extraction, and date format constants related to WebDAV operations.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a string based on the specified format string, using GMT time zone.

methods.name: getDocumentFromRequest
methods.description: Reads the InputStream from an HttpServletRequest and parses it into an XML Document object.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts user credentials (username and password) from the request parameters or HTTP Basic Authorization header.

methods.name: getRFC1123DateFormat
methods.description: Returns the RFC1123 date format string used in WebDAV headers.
